data.one_liner: A simple wrapper around libserialport for Flutter build and deployment.
data.what_it_does: It wraps the libserialport package and utilizes Flutter's build system to build and deploy the C-library under the hood for target platforms. It works out of the box without the need for manually building and deploying the underlying C-library.
use_when: You need to communicate with serial devices in your Flutter application.
You want to avoid manually building and deploying the native libserialport C-library.
avoid_when: You do not need serial port functionality.
You are targeting platforms outside of Linux, macOS, Windows, and Android.
strengths: Works out of the box without manual C-library building.
Supports multiple platforms including Linux, macOS, Windows, and Android.
weaknesses: Does not provide any additional API beyond the base libserialport package.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_libserialport as a dependency in your pubspec.yaml file. Platform-specific entitlements (such as serial device entitlement for macOS) may be required depending on your use case.
